## Column Page Inset Test

This tests the `.column-page-inset` class which spans page width but with a small inset from edges.

::: {.column-page-inset}
PAGE-INSET-CONTENT: This content should span nearly the full page width but maintain a small margin from the page edges. It's wider than column-page but not full bleed like column-screen.
:::

Regular text for comparison.

The inset provides a visual buffer from the page edges while still being wider than the body column.
